name: seis-apple-native-readiness
description: Audit bounded Apple-native Swift Package source, test, strategy, and traversal-limit evidence without compiling, signing, deploying, or claiming a live native runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Read bounded Apple/Swift Package readiness evidence locally.
interface.longDescription: Checks declared Swift Package targets, bounded Swift source and test presence, Apple platform strategy markers, and explicit traversal limits. It reports static local evidence only; it never compiles, signs, deploys, uses a network, reads secrets, or treats source markers as a native runtime, App Store, or release proof.
defaultPrompt: Audit the checked-in SEIS Apple-native Swift Package readiness without compiling or changing files.
Keep static source evidence separate from a native build, signing, release, provider, or App Store claim.
